review_comments: `e2enode.TotalReady` returns two value. Does `gomega.BeEquivalentTo` automagically handles the `err` part?
It only checks the first return value, I assume it’s fine to skip `err`, other e2e tests do the same.

The error is checked by `gomega.Eventually`. The matcher only gets invoked when the error is nil.

/lgtm
